thread:
Maria: Heads-up: prepping tonight's train. Gate time ~21:10 PT. Prioritize critical cherrypicks only. Anyone with non-essential schema work, please hold.
Alex: Saw a conflict in PR #489 (feature/auth-ttl) vs migration. I can rebase but will need a quick smoke run afterwards.
Jamie: I can take post-rebase smoke tests. Ping me when the PR is green and I'll kick off.
Riya: Infra ran an aborted deploy earlier, left a stray feature flag. I created #491 to cleanup; needs a config owner review.
Matt: Strong +1 to freezing schema. Last train the rollback time ballooned. Moving schema to next weekly deploy unless urgent.
Maria: Agreed — schema freeze for this train. Alex -> rebase. Riya -> get config approval. Jamie -> smoke. Matt -> standby for rollback assistance.
deploy-bot: Request received: schedule canary at 21:25 PT for release-2.4.0-candidate. Initial traffic 3%. CI: https://ci.internal/release/1852509999
Alex: Rebase started, will resolve feature/auth-ttl conflict and run unit tests. ETA ~12m.
Jamie: Copy that. I'll prepare the staging smoke script and logs collection so we can triage quickly if needed.
Riya: Config owner @sre-oncall notified for #491. Added test output and rollback notes.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor infra metrics and open temporary alerts if CPU or error-rate climbs during canary.
Alex: Rebase pushed -> https://git.internal/org/repo/pull/489. Added a small fix for concurrent migrations.
Jamie: Smoke run initiated on staging. Running through login flows and batch ingestion. Will post summary.
Jamie: Smoke green. No obvious regressions. Minor warning in ingestion about backpressure but within expected range.
Matt: Thanks—if backpressure looks intermittent we'll watch, but not blocking. Kick the canary.
deploy-bot: Canary started: 3% traffic. Observables: latency p95, 5xx rate, token throughput.
Maria: If 10m looks stable we bump to 25%. Keep updates short. If anything critical -> escalate to #incidents.
Jamie: +5m: metrics look fine, p95 unchanged, errors steady. +15m I'll post final status.
Alex: Note: added extra logging around migration idempotency. Should help if rollback becomes necessary.
Riya: Config cleanup approved and merged. Removed stray feature flag.
sre-oncall: No alerts so far. Raising thresholds for canary window and watching logs closely.
Maria: Great work. Switching to watch mode here. Thanks everyone — post any followups in this thread only.
